description: This PHP source file defines a database migration class for the OrangeHRM project. It modifies the 'hs_hr_emp_member_detail' table by disabling constraints, removing foreign keys, dropping and re-adding a primary key, adding an 'id' column with auto-increment, and re-enabling constraints. It also provides the migration version '4.1.1'.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A class that handles database schema migration for the specific version 4.1.1 of OrangeHRM, modifying the employee member detail table.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the schema changes: disables constraints, drops foreign keys and primary key, alters the 'id' column with auto-increment, then re-enables constraints.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string of this migration, '4.1.1'.
